page_title: Presentify: Screen Annotation, Cursor Highlight, Spotlight, Zoom

sources.entry: Presentify - A mac app to draw on your screen while on calls, highlight your cursor, and more. ![App Store][app-store Icon]

summary.name: Presentify
summary.one_liner: Presentify is a lightweight macOS app for drawing on your screen, highlighting the cursor, spotlighting areas, and zooming during presentations, demos, and screen shares.
use_cases: Annotating slides or PDFs during a live presentation
Highlighting the cursor so viewers can follow demos
Drawing diagrams on a digital whiteboard during meetings
Spotlighting or zooming on small text in screen shares
Creating tutorials or screencasts with on-screen drawing
summary.what_it_does: Presentify lets you draw on any part of the Mac screen using pens, highlighters, text, and shapes such as arrows, circles, and squares, with up to 5 colors or a gradient. Drawings can be set to auto-erase after a chosen time. It includes a digital whiteboard for sketching ideas. The cursor highlight adds a customizable ring or squircle around the pointer with click animations. Spotlight dims the rest of the screen around a chosen region, and zoom magnifies an area that follows the cursor. Most actions have keyboard shortcuts, and custom shortcuts can be set.
notable: Draw on any app, file, or video with pens, highlighters, text, and shapes, plus auto-erase
Customizable cursor halo with click animations
Spotlight and zoom views that follow the cursor
Works with Zoom, Google Meet, Keynote, PowerPoint, OBS, and Stream Deck
caveats: Page lists distribution through App Store, Setapp, and Polar but does not state prices
Mac-only; the page makes no claim of Windows or other platform support
Page is mostly marketing; performance figures (1MB download, 25MB memory, zero crashes) are the developer's own claims
